question: In engelstad_nitro.csv (corn yield trials by location, year and nitrogen rate), for the Knoxville location compute for each year the yield gain from the 0 nitrogen rate to the 335 nitrogen rate (yield at 335 minus yield at 0), then average those gains across all years. Round to 2 decimals.
solve_py:
import os,json,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/engelstad_nitro.csv');k=d[d['loc']=='Knoxville']
p=k.pivot_table(index='year',columns='nitro',values='yield')
print(round((p[335]-p[0]).mean(),2))
